seo.title: Your Company — business-class new-build apartments
seo.description: Residential complexes in Yunusabad, Mirabad and Chilanzar: apartments from 15.9M UZS per m², up to 36 months of instalments, mortgages via partner banks.
seo.answer: Your Company is a Tashkent developer building business-class residential complexes since 2014, with 9 buildings delivered. Apartments on sale start at 15,900,000 UZS per m², with interest-free instalments for up to 36 months from a 30% down payment and mortgages through partner banks. The next handover is Q4 2026.

listing.description: A website for a developer, real-estate agency or architecture firm. Architectural grid, a WebGL facade, projects with technical data, blueprint-style floor plans and mortgages.

sections.title: Homes above expectations
sections.subtitle: Four residential complexes in Tashkent: monolithic frames, ventilated facades, car-free courtyards and apartments with a ready finish.

sections.label: Company
sections.title: We build slowly, so you can live long
sections.text: We design a building from its courtyard, not its height: light, quiet and routes first, square metres second. Every project passes an independent review, construction is run by our own general contractor, and after handover the building is managed by our own management company.

items.title: Your Company Boulevard
items.text: Two towers above the boulevard and a courtyard on the podium roof, from 17,400,000 UZS per m².

items.title: Sky Garden
items.text: Apartments with garden terraces on every floor, from 19,900,000 UZS per m².

items.title: Chilonzor Park
items.text: A block of six buildings around a park, ready apartments from 15,900,000 UZS per m².

items.label: families already live in our buildings

items.title: Choose
items.text: Online or at the sales office: layout, floor, view from the window.

items.title: Reserve
items.text: We lock the price for 7 days with no prepayment.

items.title: Contract
items.text: Shared-equity purchase, instalments or a mortgage — arranged in a day.

items.title: Keys
items.text: Inspection with an engineer and handover of keys on the contract date.

items.quote: The building was delivered a month early. There are no cars in the courtyard — the kids ride scooters right from the entrance.
items.author: Jasur T.

items.quote: We bought on instalments at the foundation stage and paid no interest. At handover we found two small issues — fixed within a week.
items.author: Anna and Rustam

items.a: A down payment from 30%, the rest in equal payments over up to 36 months with no interest or price increase. Early repayment is possible at any time.

items.q: Can I buy with a mortgage?
items.a: Yes, through partner banks: the rate depends on the bank’s programme, with a down payment from 25%. Our manager gathers the documents and applies to several banks at once.
Your Company Boulevard in Q4 2026, Sky Garden in Q2 2027. Chilonzor Park is already delivered and apartments are ready to move into.

items.q: What finish do the apartments have?
items.a: White box: levelled walls and floors, electrical and plumbing runs, an entrance door and double-glazed windows. A final finish is optional, as a package from 2,900,000 UZS per m².

items.q: What documents do I need to buy?
items.a: A passport or ID card is enough for the contract. For a mortgage, the bank will also ask for proof of income.

sections.label: Sales office
sections.title: Come and see for yourself
sections.text: We’ll show you the models, floor plans and the construction site. The finished-interior showroom is at the sales office.
